title: Team member closeout: Ethereal Orbiting Eclipse (f92636) — fifth directorship delivered (five merges, main-merge, Q-008, two clean rotations, curation lane); authority with Sunlit Waxing Asteroid; zero claims retained
body:

- Boundary owned: Director, FIFTH holder (06:29:11Z Moment-2 d07e7266 → 09:26:34Z Sunlit's Moment-2 118ad69e), coordination home + all routing/dispatch/merge-serialisation.
- Outcome: FIVE merges Director-serialised with both evidence loops verified first-hand every time — #166 loud-write contract (adddc1bb), #167 EDGE_TYPES predicate (82d57b4d), #168 turbo env (13b99bd2), #169 ARC reference (e0f6e5de, after a thread-resolution catch), #170 lifecycle-lease cure (3038240c) — plus origin/main merged INTO the coordination home (ae1802da1; Q-008 resolved by owner, branching strategy codified in the opener + prompts README). Lanes delivered under this hold: the full reliability micro-queue through three holders; the Arboreal curation pass (incl. the owner-ratified verify-dont-trust graduation, landed after a refuted word-identical claim forced loss-free repairs); G4b c1+c2 through two seat rotations (both PDR-063-clean, one resolved a live-incumbent contention with zero double-edits); the n=3 ARC team bootstrap + seat handover. Routing throughout: G4b, curation lane, micro-queue split, two succession pre-positionings.
- Evidence: waypoints 0149bb5b, ea7a615a7, f8c4d708 (+ two succession-window commits, see in-flight); comms events throughout; merge SHAs above.
- Claims / queue / git state: ZERO retained — 0a8075f4 closed citing 118ad69e; 718b1d24 + 15bc9b5d closed discharged (loud-verified); queue empty of my intents. IN FLIGHT, transfers to Sunlit Waxing Asteroid (sole writer from Moment 2): the coordination home is AHEAD 2 unpushed (f8c4d708 final waypoint + the succession-window lint-repair/state commit) — the push races live appends to the n=3 ARC channel files at the pre-push markdownlint gate; land with a fresh lint-fix + push in your first continuity window. Also yours per your absorbed queue: Cindery + retired-seat identity rows (my waypoint carries nine rows through Sunlit; Cindery's row is in it).
- Session complete announcement: YES — Ethereal Orbiting Eclipse (f92636) stands down at the completed succession.
- Retained claims: NONE.
- Pickup notification required: none — Sunlit Waxing Asteroid (14a56a) is active with claim 1d37fdfe and the full Moment-1 package (f0126218).
- Heartbeat-end broadcast emitted: follows immediately.
- Surprise or changed understanding: (1) the silent-write class closed structurally mid-session — my own claims-close failed LOUD on a guessed UUID hours after routing the fix; the cure validated itself in live Director use; (2) `pnpm agent-tools:check-commit-message -F file` is a false green (pnpm eats -F as --filter) — tool-fix note for the queue; (3) a liveness inference from a single missed cadence is wrong by construction — the 240s heartbeat + 10-min threshold did its job twice today; the pre-default ping and the incumbent's own signal are what protect the worktree; (4) owner decisions as explicit questions (standing UX direction, auto-memory) changed two outcomes this session — both ratifications were instant where prose verdicts had previously sat unactioned.
- Blockers or risks: none beyond the named unpushed commits. G4b c3 executing (Cindery); n=3 team mapped X/Y/Z with two PRs already delivered.
- Handoff needed: COMPLETE — Moment-1 f0126218 + Sunlit's Moment-2 118ad69e + this closeout.
